title: Tracks with album titles
statementMd:
For tracks 1 to 6 show track title and album title.

Expected columns: `track`, `album`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.title AS track, al.title AS album FROM tracks t JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id WHERE t.id <= 6;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
